explanation: Pixar made it, and Disney released it. Buzz Lightyear took his first name from Apollo 11 astronaut Buzz Aldrin.

claims.text: Toy Story (1995) was the first feature film made entirely with computer animation.
A Bug's Life (1998), Antz (1998) and Shrek (2001) all came out after 1995.
Toy Story was made by Pixar and released by Disney.
Buzz Lightyear's first name was taken from Apollo 11 astronaut Buzz Aldrin.
